It is the second track and lead single from the band's fourth studio album, "Nobody's Daughter", and was released on March 12, 2010 on Mercury Records.  Written by vocalist Courtney Love and lead guitarist Micko Larkin, "Skinny Little Bitch" was Hole's first single in a decade and first release not to feature founding member Eric Erlandson.
